en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from Salama b. al-Khattab from `Ali b. al-Hasan from Ahmad b. Muhammad al-Mu’addab from `Asim b. Humayd from Khalid al-Qalanisi. He said: Al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) said:

An elderly man will come on the Day of Resurrection, and he will be given his book. On the apparent, it will have what he partook in by following the people, and he will only see disappointment. That will be prolonged for him; so, he will say: “O Lord! Will you send me to the Fire?!” So, the Almighty will say: “O elderly man! I would be ashamed to punish you because you would pray in the abode of the world. Go with My servants to Paradise.”
